Name: Cintas Corporation
Description: Cintas Corporation is a leading American provider of business-to-business services, headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio. The company specializes in uniform rental and facility services, offering a comprehensive range of products including uniforms, mats, mops, cleaning and restroom supplies, as well as safety products such as first aid kits and fire extinguishers. With a strong emphasis on customer service and operational efficiency, Cintas serves a diverse clientele across multiple industries, positioning itself as a critical partner in enhancing workplace safety and appearance. The company’s commitment to quality and innovation reflects its strong market presence and growth potential within the essential services sector.
Address: 6800 CINTAS BOULEVARD, CINCINNATI, OH, UNITED STATES, 45262-5737
